_comment: Frozen run settings and secondary-measure definitions for Study 2. Fixed on 2026-10-26 and revised on 2026-11-07, both before the freeze commit and before any Study 2 API call. Changing anything here after the freeze commit is a protocol deviation and must be logged in README.md (Deviations).

seeds.rater_sheet_ids_and_order: secret random salt drawn by human_subsample_study2.py build-sheets, stored only in the hidden key

pilot.note: Pilot outputs are archived under results/pilot/ and never analysed. The same items are re-run in the full run.

api_call.reasoning_effort: not passed (API default). The OpenAI model pages list 'none' as the default for all three GPT-5.4 snapshots (checked 2026-10-26); reasoning_tokens are logged on every call to confirm 0.
api_call.messages: system = arm prompt, user = messified text only (same split as the prior exploratory run)

budget_note: Cap covers pilot + full run together. Cost is computed from logged usage and the per-tier prices in config/model_lineup.json; cached input tokens are charged at the full input price (conservative).

extraction.final_line: the LAST 'FINAL REQUIREMENT:' tag that starts a line (markdown markers * # _ ` > and spaces allowed before it, case-insensitive); if none starts a line, the last exact upper-case tag anywhere. Answer = first line after the tag that still has text once markdown markers and spaces are removed.
extraction.final_json: same tag rule for 'FINAL JSON:'; the JSON object after it; its 'requirement' field
extraction.first_tag_rule_for_sensitivity: FIRST tag, case-insensitive, anywhere; first non-empty line (the prior run's extraction rule, archive/study1/scripts/extract_answers.py)
extraction.completeness: exactly one successful record per planned (item, arm, model) call, all from the frozen prompt version; otherwise extraction stops

primary_outcome: ears_v2_compliant from scripts/check_ears_compliance_v2.py (unchanged, sha256 4a9bb37b78851e01bf600f65d117f74c9583412f4f1f5938233daaa477c20e8f). Extraction failures count as non-compliant.

human_evaluation.note: The 2026-10-01 rater calibration discussed outputs for PURE-002, PURE-014 and PURE-017. PURE-002 and PURE-014 are in the human subsample; the S6 confirmatory comparisons are repeated without them (ANALYSIS_PLAN.md, S6).

secondary_measures.template_slot: checker v2 fail reason 'template_slot' (an unfilled <...> slot, e.g. '<system name>')

register_leakage.definition: normalized requirement text contains any LEAK_TERMS entry as a whole phrase, case-insensitive (regex (?<![a-z])term(?![a-z]) on ' '+lower(text)+' ')

transcription.definition: share of the normalized requirement's tokens covered by word 4-grams that also occur in the messified input >= 0.5; tokens = re.findall(r"[a-z0-9']+", lower(text))

secondary_measures.length_words: word count of the normalized requirement (descriptive only)
secondary_measures.denominator: outputs with an extractable requirement (extraction failures are reported separately)
